meta.seeding: state for frame k = reference ff of frame k-1 (cal xy after a lost bead) - CPU seeds EVERY frame, so deltas do not accumulate across frames

columns: frames[i] = [k, frame, d0x,d0y,d0z, d1x,... ] with null where the bead was skipped (bad in / reference -1) and the flip marked in flip_bk
